basic_info.description: Beautiful Bernal Heights 2 unit building offering spacious units, curb appeal, and income potential in a desirable location. Excellent opportunity to live and invest in this popular neighborhood. The vacant, lower unit features a huge layout over 2 levels. Its main level has an open kitchen and dining area, a large living room, a bedroom, and 2 bathrooms. This level boasts soaring ceilings and over-sized windows. Its lower level offers a lot of flexible space that can be wonderful for multigenerational use, guests, and working from home. This level provides direct access to the yard, which has space for unwinding and barbecuing. Upper unit comprises 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. It is tenant-occupied. Both units are equipped with their own washer and dryer. The property has a garage and there is a nice-sized parking pad and storage area for the vacant unit. Located by Holly Park and Saint Mary's Recreation Center. Enjoy being near the numerous popular restaurants, cafes, shops, and nightlife on Mission St., Cortland Ave., and Diamond St. Quick access to BART, 101 and 280. Bernal Heights is a beloved neighborhood for its weather, community, and proximity to the Mission, Glen Park, and Noe Valley. Opportunity to buy a big building with long-term upside for the price  of a condo.
